reuse.why: Extracts the range rule into getRangedAmount and uses it from getScheduledAmount, but the callers keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The six inline midpoint formulas are replaced by one function; the surrounding per-site dispatch ternaries that copy getScheduledAmount stay duplicated, though the diff does not add new copies.

placement.why: The range rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where amount resolution already lives.

scope.why: Touches only the range sites, comments, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The range rule is now defined once and easy to change; leaving five call-site dispatches means the next amount rule (e.g. for approximate amounts) still has to be threaded through each.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules.ts, schedule-template.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions call getRangedAmount inside their own dispatch instead of getScheduledAmount

one_place.where: getRangedAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used directly by every server site and through getScheduledAmount by the client
